title: Ultra-Stable Environment Control for the NEID Spectrometer
what_was_studied: Thirty-day full-system vacuum and thermal stability test before commissioning
numerical_result: Vacuum remained below 1e-6 Torr and RMS temperature stability was better than 0.4 mK over 30 days
remaining_question: Environmental stability is a subsystem result and not an achieved stellar RV RMS

title: Observing the Sun as a star: Design and early results from the NEID solar feed
what_was_studied: Four months of commissioning Sun-as-a-star observations under selected sky conditions
numerical_result: Solar RMS was 0.66 m/s under good conditions and 0.41 m/s for the best-condition subset
remaining_question: Condition-selected solar stability is not a universal stellar or multi-year instrument floor

title: Real-time exposure control and instrument operation with the NEID spectrograph GUI
what_was_studied: Exposure control, queue ingestion, calibration configuration and exposure-meter monitoring
numerical_result: The interface supports shutter triggering at a requested SNR and exposes changing conditions and guiding failures
remaining_question: Operational consistency supports but does not quantify long-term RV accuracy

title: Stable fiber-illumination for extremely precise radial velocities with NEID
what_was_studied: Optical fibre feed, scramblers, exposure meter and commissioning tests
numerical_result: HR mode R about 112000 over 380 to 930 nm; single-visit instrumental requirement is 0.27 m/s
remaining_question: The requirement is not an achieved end-to-end value and illumination errors can be invisible to the simultaneous calibrator

title: The Extreme Stellar-Signals Project III: Combining Solar Data from HARPS HARPS-N EXPRES and NEID
what_was_studied: Contemporaneous solar observations used to separate shared solar variability from instrument-specific effects
numerical_result: Pairwise residual unexplained scatter was 0.15 to 0.30 m/s; a late-day EXPRES-NEID trend was about 0.73 m/s per hour
remaining_question: The late-day trend is consistent with an airmass or differential-extinction explanation but is not uniquely attributed

title: Earths within Reach: Evaluation of Strategies for Mitigating Solar Variability
what_was_studied: NEID solar observations from 2021-01-01 through 2024-06-30 curated for community analysis
numerical_result: 117060 observations were identified as unlikely to be significantly affected by weather, hardware or major calibration issues
remaining_question: A curated count does not by itself quantify planet-signal preservation by an activity model

title: NEID DRP 1.5.2 master files and RV eras
what_was_studied: Versioned wavelength masters, LFC and etalon line lists, and hardware-event RV eras
numerical_result: Documentation flags known order-edge systematics in the ThAr master and separate pre/post-2024 and pre/post-2025 etalon files
remaining_question: The size of each residual effect must be measured on defined data rather than inferred from file versioning
